reasons: With an 8 MC limit, semesters 4-8 allow at most 10 four-MC courses.
CS4236 needs CS2107 and CS4212 needs CS2104, so 11 courses are required.
The fixed ST2334, CS4222/CS3219 pair, and CS4212 in semester 8 leave no room for all 11.
